```yaml
name: Build and Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cargo install --force cargo-release
          npm install

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test

      - name: Create release bundle
        id: create_release_bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-bundle
          cp target/release/platformatic-php-node-linux-x64-gnu release-bundle/
          cp target/release/platformatic-php-node-darwin-arm64 release-bundle/
          tar -czvf release-bundle.tar.gz release-bundle/

      - name: Upload release bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: npm-platformatic-php-node-linux-x64-gnu
          path: release-bundle.tar.gz
```

```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          scope: '@platformatic'

      - name: Authenticate to npm
        run: echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" > ~/.npmrc

      - name: Bump version
        run: node scripts/update-version.mjs ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}

      - name: Publish package
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NODE_AUTH_TOKEN }}
```

```javascript
// scripts/update-version.mjs
const { execSync } = require('child_process');
const semver = require('semver');

const newVersion = process.argv[2];

if (!newVersion || !semver.valid(newVersion)) {
  console.error('Please provide a valid semantic version.');
  process.exit(1);
}

execSync(`npm version ${newVersion} --no-git-tag-version`);
console.log(`Updated version to ${newVersion}`);
```
